description: This file provides utility functions for processing weather forecast data, mapping weather codes to conditions, generating clothing recommendations based on forecast data, and mocking popular places for a city. It relies on external modules from 'pydantic' and internal modules like 'src.api.main' to define data models such as DailyForecast, ClothingRecommendation, and PopularPlace.

classes.name: DailyForecast
classes.description: Data model representing daily weather forecast details, imported from 'src.api.main'.

classes.name: ClothingRecommendation
classes.description: Data model for clothing tips per day, imported from 'src.api.main'.

classes.name: PopularPlace
classes.description: Data model for a popular place in a city, imported from 'src.api.main'.

methods.name: str _weathercode_to_condition(code: int)
methods.description: Converts a weather code into a descriptive weather condition string.

methods.name: List[DailyForecast] map_open_meteo_to_daily_forecast(data: Dict)
methods.description: Transforms the Open-Meteo weather forecast dictionary into a list of DailyForecast instances.

methods.name: List[str] _clothing_tips_for_day(day: DailyForecast)
methods.description: Generates clothing tips for a given day's weather forecast based on temperature, condition, and precipitation.

methods.name: List[ClothingRecommendation] get_clothing_recommendations_for_forecast(forecast: List[DailyForecast])
methods.description: Creates a list of ClothingRecommendation objects for a sequence of daily forecasts.

methods.name: List[PopularPlace] mock_popular_places_for_city(city: str, country: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of mocked popular places for a given city, with city-specific defaults.
